ok.description: False when a required borrow scope or populated managed namespace could not be inspected.

dry_run.description: True when nothing was removed. Reap is dry-run unless --execute is passed.

holding_unlanded_work.description: Kept worktrees carrying commits no remote carries. The only protection class whose removal could destroy work.

complete.description: True only when required safety scopes were fully inspected; false on failure or load deferral.

incomplete_scopes.description: Required stores or managed discovery namespaces that were missing or unreadable. No removal is allowed.

deferred.description: Why inspection was deferred without treating an empty result as a complete inventory.

reason.description: Why a worktree was kept. Empty for a reaped entry.

holds_unlanded_work.description: The worktree carries commits whose content no remote carries.

non_disposable_ignored.description: Ignored paths that kept the worktree because they are not provably rebuildable; configure daemon.auto_reap_disposable_ignored or remove them.
